set.body: Cover template_similarity_cv, template_regression and template_multireg with shared feature and response construction. Implement one supported basic fit through a typed optional adapter or executable R export/reimport route. Fold identities and fitted parameters must prove training-only fitting; predictions retain trial keys and failures. Exit with a held-out leakage mutant, independent small linear case, saved recipe and documented deferral of rlm, nnls and logistic variants not shipped.
set.title: Deliver a leakage-free basic template-model route
